title: A feature with many exact rules across two squads
skill: a multi-file feature whose edge cases are all in the spec: rounding, inclusive dates, limits, error messages
request: Add discount codes at checkout. In core, add applyDiscount(cents, code, today) to src/core/money.js, using the codes defined in src/core/codes.js. It returns { total, discount } in integer cents, or throws an Error whose message is exactly 'unknown code', 'expired' or 'minimum not met'. Rules: codes match in any case ('save10' works); percent discounts round half up to whole cents (10% off 1005 is a discount of 101, total 904); a fixed discount never takes the total below 0 (the discount is then the whole order); a code is valid through its expires date inclusive, where today is a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string (SAVE10 works on '2026-12-31' and is expired on '2027-01-01'); a code with minCents applies only when cents is at least minCents. In the API, src/api/router.js should answer { path: '/checkout', query: { cents, code, today } } (query values are strings) with { status: 200, body: { total, discount } }; when the code is refused, with status 400 and body { error } holding that exact message; and with status 400 and body { error: 'bad request' } when cents is missing, not a whole number, or negative, or today is missing. Keep formatCents and the existing routes working.

plan.summary: Core adds applyDiscount over the code table; the API exposes it on /checkout.

tasks.title: applyDiscount in core money
tasks.objective: Export applyDiscount(cents, code, today) from src/core/money.js following every stated rule, using CODES from src/core/codes.js.
acceptanceCriteria: valid on the expiry day, 'expired' the day after
tasks.testPlan: unit tests per rule: rounding, case, expiry boundary, minimum, floor at zero, unknown code

tasks.title: /checkout route
tasks.objective: Answer /checkout in src/api/router.js using applyDiscount, mapping refused codes and bad input to 400 as stated.

a refused code answers 400 with its message
missing, non-whole or negative cents, or missing today, answers 400 'bad request'
